headline: The best classic slasher movie you'll never watch
summary: This article explores the 1980 horror franchise 'Camp Miasma.' The series generated multiple sequels, arcade games, and extensive merchandise. It's highlighted as a classic slasher movie many may not know.

headline: Why does Apple keep banning Telegram, but never X?
summary: Telegram briefly vanished from Apple's App Store this week, despite its global user base. The ban raises questions about Apple's inconsistent enforcement policies compared to platforms like X. Telegram is widely used as a secure communication platform.

headline: Trying to explain One Night Only's tech-enforced sex dystopia
summary: The movie 'One Night Only' features a terrifying premise: single people can only have sex one night a year. It subverts traditional romantic comedy tropes with its tech-enforced dystopian setting. The article delves into the film's absurd and unsettling concept.

headline: Meta ordered to pay an additional $567 million in public nuisance ruling
summary: Meta has been ordered to pay an additional $567 million in New Mexico's child safety case. This brings total charges against the company to nearly $1 billion. The court found Meta's platforms contribute significantly to teen mental health issues.

headline: Amazon Knocks $10 off Physical Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Preorders
summary: Amazon is offering a $10 discount on physical preorders for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. This deal matches the digital pricing for the upcoming game. Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is set to launch in October this year.

headline: LEGO Harry Potter Celebrates 25 Years With Ministry of Magic Set, and The First-Ever Minifigure of a Specific Character
summary: LEGO Harry Potter is celebrating its 25th anniversary with a new Ministry of Magic set. This special release includes the first-ever Minifigure of Arabella Figg. Fans can mark a quarter-century of the beloved LEGO series.

headline: Brainrot Royale Brings Some Of The Internet's Wildest Characters To PUBG MOBILE's World of Wonder
summary: PUBG MOBILE's World of Wonder is introducing 'Brainrot Royale.' This update integrates some of the internet's most unconventional characters into the game. Players can expect a fresh and wild new experience.

headline: Rockstar Owner Take-Two Confirms GTA 6 Release Date Still on Track, Says 'GTA 6: An Extended Look' Will Help Grow 'Consumers' Passion and Anticipation'
summary: Take-Two, Rockstar's owner, confirms GTA 6's November 19 release date remains on schedule. An upcoming 'GTA 6: An Extended Look' is planned to build excitement. This preview aims to boost consumer anticipation for the game.

headline: Academics call for independent inquiry into Jason Arday's Cambridge appointment
summary: Academics are demanding an independent inquiry into Jason Arday's appointment at Cambridge. Prof Priyamvada Gopal argues that Cambridge should not be allowed to 'mark its own homework.' The call highlights concerns over transparency and due process.

headline: Officer who led PC Harper investigation 'appalled' killers could be released early
summary: Former Det Sup Stuart Blaik is 'appalled' at the potential early release of PC Harper's killers. Blaik, who led the investigation, has publicly voiced his concerns for the first time. The statement reignites debate around the high-profile case.

headline: England footballer Ivan Toney charged with assault at Soho nightclub
summary: England footballer Ivan Toney has been charged with assault following an incident. The alleged assault occurred at a Soho nightclub. The former Brentford striker is scheduled to appear in court next month.

headline: How a 90-second power outage sparked chaos for rail commuters
summary: A mere 90-second power outage led to widespread chaos for rail commuters. The incident raised questions about how a brief disruption can cause such extensive impact. It highlighted vulnerabilities in the rail power supply system.
